page: Microsoft Azure NV8ads_V710_v5 is a virtual machine instance within the NVadsV710v5 family, powered by an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and is Premium Storage capable, supporting high-performance external storage configurations.

This instance incorporates a fractional GPU configuration, providing 0.3333 of an AMD V710 GPU with 7 GB of dedicated VRAM. This fractional allocation allows workloads to leverage hardware acceleration without the cost overhead of a full physical GPU. For local storage, the instance is equipped with a 550 GB NVMe SSD, offering fast local read and write speeds for temporary files and caching. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included.

The NV8ads_V710_v5 is designed for workloads requiring moderate GPU acceleration and balanced CPU-to-memory resources. Suitable applications include virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), entry-level 3D visualization, computer-aided design (CAD), and lightweight machine learning inference. The fractional GPU model provides a cost-efficient alternative to full-GPU instances, aligning resource allocation closely with actual processing requirements.
